hcmix_fp32.why: float32 vs float64, per element of post [B,S,hc] and comb [B,S,hc,hc]; both are strictly positive (sigmoid * 2 and a softmax + eps) so no cancellation. mixes = x . fn (hc*D <= 64 terms: sqrt(64) u |term| ~ 5e-7 relative to the logit scale), sigmoid / softmax (<= 4 ulp), and up to 2 x 19 further Sinkhorn divisions after the first (each <= 1 ulp, contractive so random-walk: sqrt(40) u = 3.8e-7). Total <= ~1.5e-6; 1e-5 = 6x margin.

hcpost_bf16.why: x and residual are bfloat16-exact and post/comb are float32, so the Swift result is computed in float32 (promotion) and rounded to bfloat16 once: |round(v) - v| <= 2^-8 |v| (round to nearest, 8-bit significand, u = 3.9e-3) <= 3.9e-3 max|want| in the normwise sense; 4e-3 = u + float32 compute (<= 1e-6) + 2% margin.

out_fp32.why: float32 compute vs float64 truth, max|got-want| <= atol + rtol * max|want| over the tensor (normwise because these outputs are sums with cancellation). Two or three chained matmuls with <= 32 terms (sqrt(n) u |term| ~ 3.4e-7 each), silu/sigmoid/softmax/exp (<= 4 ulp = 2.4e-7), up to 20 Sinkhorn normalisations (contractive: random-walk sqrt(40) u = 3.8e-7) and a cancellation factor sum|terms|/|sum| <= ~5: ~2e-6 worst case; 5e-6 = that + 2.5x margin. atol 1e-9 only covers an all-zero tensor and the 1e-12 text rounding of the golden.

route_w_bf16.why: bfloat16 compute vs float64 truth of the bf16-rounded inputs. The Swift gate runs matmul in bf16 (vLLM: GateLinear out_dtype=float32, CM:136-142), so the logit is rounded to bf16: relative 2^-9 = 1.95e-3 of |l| <= 4, i.e. <= 7.8e-3 absolute, which becomes <= 3.9e-3 relative in the score (d ln score/dl <= 1/2). sqrtSoftplus then does exp, log1p, add, sqrt, each rounding to bf16: 5 x 1.95e-3 x (1/2 for the sqrt) + 1.95e-3 = 6.8e-3. takeAlong is exact; the k-term sum, the divide and the scale multiply add 3 roundings = 5.9e-3. Total <= 1.66e-2; 2.5e-2 = that + 50% margin. This tolerance documents bf16 precision; it is NOT a claim that bf16 logits equal fp32 logits.

route_w_fp32.why: float32 compute vs float64 truth, per routing weight (all weights are positive, so a per-element relative bound is meaningful). Logit = sum over H<=32 terms: float32 matmul error ~ sqrt(H) u |term| <= 1e-6 absolute for |logit| <= 8 (u = 2^-24 = 6e-8). score = sqrt(softplus(l)): d ln(score)/dl = sigmoid(l) / (2 softplus(l)) <= 1/2 for every l, so the score's relative error is <= 5e-7 from the logit plus ~4 ulp (2.4e-7) from exp/log1p/add/sqrt. Normalisation (sum of k<=6 values, one divide) and the routed scale add ~3 ulp (1.8e-7). Total <= ~1.0e-6; 5e-6 = that + 5x margin.
